name: AI Deco
description: Select objects in the editor and prompt Claude to decorate them.

api-key.name: Anthropic API Key
api-key.description: Your Claude API key from console.anthropic.com. Stored in plain text in your Geode save folder, so don't share your save files.

model.name: Model
model.description: Opus gives the best layouts. Sonnet and Haiku are faster and cheaper.

effort.name: Effort
effort.description: How hard the model thinks. Lower is faster.

max-objects.name: Max Generated Objects
max-objects.description: Upper limit on objects created per generation.

max-context-objects.name: Max Selection Objects Sent
max-context-objects.description: How many selected objects are described to the AI. Bigger selections are truncated.

extra-palette.name: Extra Object IDs
extra-palette.description: Object IDs the AI may use besides those in your selection. Format: id:description, comma-separated. Example: 1764:small dot,211:black block
